data.name: Biochar Life
data.description: Biochar Life is a Delaware Public Benefit Corporation and impact venture of the nonprofit Warm Heart Worldwide, headquartered operationally in northern Thailand with programs in Kenya, Malawi, and Indonesia. It trains smallholder farmers to pyrolyze crop waste into biochar, verifies carbon removal under the EBC/Global Artisan C-Sink standard, and sells C-sink credits through partners including Carbonfuture.
